headline: As of 2026-10-05: 1,267,350 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 30 of 50 states, D+34.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,267,350 early/mail ballots cast so far across 30 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+34.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (349,576), New Jersey (178,984), Florida (151,273).
